packages.name: AcuRite Temperature Sensor Mqtt Driver
packages.description: A device driver that integrates Acurite sensors via MQTT and RTL_433. It provides real-time temperature and humidity readings using MQTT.

packages.name: WLED MQTT LED Driver Plus
packages.description: A driver for controlling WLED devices over MQTT.  Features include on/off, dimming, RGB color control, color temperature, effects with speed/intensity, palettes, presets, and multi-segment support.
